meaning:
1) to move, go, turn back, move away, backslide
1a) (Qal) to backslide, prove recreant to
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to turn oneself away, turn back
1b2) to be turned or driven back, be repulsed
Also means: sug (שׂוּג "to turn back" H7734)

renderings.kjv: Every one of them is gone back
So will not we go back
And them that are turned back

elsewhere.note: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
“Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.
‘Behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah’s house will be brought out to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women will say, “Your familiar…
those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.
